d: Donald Trump, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin are set for an unprecedented trilateral meeting in China's Shenzhen. Three leaders, three nuclear powers and roughly 90% of the world's nuclear weapons — but what do they really want from this summit? Meanwhile, A mysterious outage at the US National Security Agency (NSA) has raised fresh questions about global cybersecurity and the vulnerability of critical technology infrastructure. A highly classified communications network reportedly went down following a software update, forcing the intelligence agency to restrict staff access as it worked…
